skill_name: Name three benefits of using a given technology
workflow: Three benefits of using cloud computing include increased scalability and cost efficiency, improved security and reliability, and faster deployment of services. Cloud computing allows for easy scalability to meet changing needs, as more services and resources can be added and managed easily. Additionally, cost efficiency is improved with cloud services as costs are usually lower than in traditional hosting services.
